reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes), wet

description.lithology: Dark grey to black medium-grained foliated mafic gneiss, amphibole-biotite veined gneiss, with migmatitic fabric and irregular discontinuous white to light grey quartz-feldspathic leucosome lenses and veins subparallel to gneissic foliation.

anomalies.explanation: Irregular white quartz-feldspathic leucosome veins and patches occur throughout all rows and should be checked to confirm vein mineralogy and contacts.
